main.description: One reading of my physical state, sampled from an iPhone and Apple Watch. An append-only log: records are never edited, so an is.braxton.now status can point at the reading taken alongside it.

heartRate.description: Heart rate in beats per minute. 0 means no reading.

activity.description: How I was moving: the label from the Shortcuts action Get Physical Activity, lowercased. Other labels than the known values can appear.
